"use server";

import { z } from "zod";

// createPost — generated by @codai/axiom-emitters-web (web@2.0.0).

const createPostSchema = z.object({
  title: z.string().min(1),
  views: z.coerce.number(),
  published: z.coerce.boolean(),
  author: z.email(),
});

export interface CreatePostState {
  ok: boolean;
  errors: Record<string, string[]>;
  values: Partial<z.output<typeof createPostSchema>>;
}

export const initialCreatePostState: CreatePostState = { ok: false, errors: {}, values: {} };

export async function createPost(
  _prev: CreatePostState,
  formData: FormData,
): Promise<CreatePostState> {
  const parsed = createPostSchema.safeParse({
    title: formData.get("title"),
    views: formData.get("views"),
    published: formData.get("published"),
    author: formData.get("author"),
  });
  if (!parsed.success) {
    const flat = z.flattenError(parsed.error);
    return { ok: false, errors: flat.fieldErrors as Record<string, string[]>, values: {} };
  }
  return { ok: true, errors: {}, values: parsed.data };
}
